hero.badge: ADDNEXO ERP — The evolution of CIMA
hero.subtitle: The lightweight ERP designed to control inventory, sales, shipments, and billing. Eliminate Excel, automate critical processes, and make data-driven decisions in real time.

stats.headline: The platform that transforms how companies operate

features.subtitle: Each module is designed to connect with the others, creating a complete and frictionless operational flow.
features.f1Desc: Real-time stock control with low inventory alerts, movement history, and advanced search.
features.f2Desc: Generate invoices with automatic calculations and tax handling. Export to PDF and track payment statuses.
features.f3Desc: Manage clients, create quotes, and follow the complete lifecycle from order to shipment.
features.f4Desc: End-to-End traceability on every shipment. Track the status of each delivery from the warehouse to the client.
features.f5Desc: Detailed control of pending payments, transaction history, and accounts receivable tracking.
features.f6Desc: Real-time financial analysis with exportable reports. Make strategic decisions with concrete data.

problems.subtitle: Many companies operate with these problems daily without knowing there is a better way. We built it.
items: Total lack of inventory and merchandise control
Excessive and inefficient reliance on Excel
Errors in billing and manual calculations
No real tracking of payments and collections

howItWorks.subtitle: Designed so any company can adopt the system quickly, without months of setup or costly consulting.

steps.title: Centralize your information
steps.desc: Import your current data and connect all your processes: inventory, clients, suppliers, and products on a single platform.

steps.title: Automate your processes
steps.desc: The system generates invoices, updates stock, registers payments, and issues alerts automatically. You focus on growing.

steps.title: Decide with real data
steps.desc: Access financial reports, shipment traceability, and real-time operational analysis to make better decisions.

benefits.subtitle: Companies that implement the system report concrete results in the first weeks.

items.title: Total centralization
items.desc: A single system for your entire operation. No information silos, no friction between departments.

items.title: Critical automation
items.desc: Repetitive processes run on their own. Your team focuses on what really adds value.

items.title: Zero human errors

items.title: Data-driven decisions
items.desc: Real-time financial and operational reports to lead with information, not intuition.

items.title: Complete traceability

items.title: Operational scalability
items.desc: The system grows with your business. Add modules and users according to your company's needs.

items.title: Higher productivity
items.desc: Less time on manual tasks, more time on strategy. Your team does more with less effort.

items.title: Total financial control
items.desc: Complete visibility over income, expenses, and accounts receivable. Finances always under control.
